```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat(sep = "\n", c(
  if (dR$own$numberOfDepartments != "1") {
    c(
      term_label(sR$headerList$numberOfDepartments, sR),
      "",
      paste0(":   ", dR$own$numberOfDepartments),
      ""
    )
  },
  term_label(sR$headerList$numberOfPatients, sR),
  "",
  paste0(":   ", dR$own$numberOfPatients),
  "",
  term_label(sR$headerList$numberOfAdmissions, sR),
  "",
  paste0(":   ", dR$own$numberOfAdmissions,
    if (dR$own$numberOfAdmissions != dR$own$numberOfPatients)
      paste0("^[", sR$headerList$admissionsExceedRecordsNote, "]")
    else ""),
  "",
  term_label(sR$headerList$sumOfPatientDays, sR),
  "",
  paste0(":   ", dR$own$sumOfPatientDays),
  "",
  term_label(sR$headerList$averageSurveillancePeriod, sR),
  "",
  paste0(":   ", interpolate_translation(
    sR$headerList$averageSurveillancePeriodValue, days = dR$own$averageSurveillancePeriod))
))
```
